user.title: Add a screen
user.description: Google TV: keep its Cast entity for playback detection and select the Android TV Remote for foreground activity. Browser mode opens the full dashboard URL through the remote; power and activity signals are required. Unknown or unavailable idle signals block automatic launches.

data.name: Screen name
data.playback_entity: Playback entity (use Google Cast for Google TV)
data.power_entity: Screen power entity (required for browser transport)
data.activity_entity: Foreground app entity (Google TV: select the Remote, not Media player)
data.idle_guard: Additional idle guard (on = safe to show dashboard)
data.remote_entity: Android TV remote for browser and app launching
data.cast_receiver_apps: Cast receiver foreground app IDs (comma separated)
data.browser_app: Browser foreground app ID (TV Bro: com.phlox.tvwebbrowser)

error.missing_guard: Select a foreground app entity or an idle guard. Idle playback alone cannot detect native apps.
error.missing_script: Select a script to open the dashboard.
error.missing_path: Set both the dashboard and view URL paths.
error.missing_remote: Select the Android TV remote used to open the browser.
error.missing_activity: Select a foreground app entity so Homeboard can avoid reopening the browser or interrupting other apps.
error.missing_power: Select the actual TV screen power entity. A Cast receiver can stay online with the screen off.
error.invalid_browser_url: Enter the full HTTP or HTTPS dashboard URL without embedded username/password credentials.
error.missing_browser_app: Enter the browser foreground app ID.
